title: Roux Sauce

titles.subject: Food and Nutrition
titles.chapter: Basic Proportions and Methods of Making

author: EJHcv6GrpmCFmfDvc
chapter_outcomes: Understand the basic proportions used in the preparation of biscuits, cookies, scones, cakes, pastries, sauces, batters, and yeast products.
Understand and apply the creaming, melting, one-stage, rubbing-in, and whisking methods in the production of biscuits, cookies, scones, and cakes.
Understand and apply the methods used to make shortcrust pastry, flaky pastry, and rough puff pastry.
Understand the preparation of pouring and coating sauces using roux-based and blended methods.
Understand the difference between thin (pouring) batters and coating batters and their uses in food preparation.
Understand the processes involved in making sweet and savoury yeast products.
